sources.title: 韩国国图《子平三命通變淵源》木板本
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; National Library of Korea
sources.quality_notes: MARC and holding row bind the 2-juan single-volume print and the abbreviated preface note. The first-party NLK search links CNTS-00047981971 to this KOL. The CNTS native viewer does not supply page images in this environment.

sources.title: 奎章阁《子平三命通變淵源》40张抄本
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies, Seoul National University
sources.quality_notes: Confirms one manuscript of 40 leaves and preface and postface notes; the precise exemplar used in the 2023 Korean translation remains unverified.

sources.title: 高丽大学《子平三命通變淵源》花山藏木版本
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Korea University Library
sources.quality_notes: Two juan in one book. The catalog assigns the Injo-Hyeonjong span and separately quotes the preface and postface, including 字元. Neither estimate nor quoted ending has been confirmed from original pages.

sources.title: 全南大学《子平三命通變淵源》93张抄本
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Chonnam National University Library
sources.quality_notes: The 93-leaf copy is separately cataloged. Its [寶]佑 preface notation is catalog-only and no graphic collation is asserted.

sources.title: 韩国国图1984《通變淵源》複寫本
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; National Library of Korea
sources.quality_notes: The National Library catalog lists a 66-leaf reproduction and identifies Dong-A University Seokdang Institute (3)-7-6-30 as source holder; the premodern exemplar was not inspected.

sources.title: 韩国国图1958《紫微斗數全書》四卷二册
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; National Library of Korea
sources.quality_notes: Catalog dates the print to 1958 and transcribes 竹林書局發行 and 嘉靖庚戌…羅洪先. The NLK search links CNTS-00047977017 to this KOL. The dated preface page itself was not obtained.

sources.title: 高丽大学广益书局《紫微斗數全書》四卷四册
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Korea University Library
sources.quality_notes: The catalog labels [19--], Shanghai Guangyi, lithograph, four juan/four books, outer title 校正紫微斗數全書 and 陳希尹補輯. The precise impression and presence of a Luo preface remain unproved.

sources.title: 岭南大学校經山房《改良紫微斗數全書》四册
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Yeungnam University Central Library
sources.quality_notes: The catalog identifies Shanghai, 校經山房, a four-book lithograph and the label 改良紫微斗數全書. The date and any Luo preface require original pages.

sources.title: 济州大学校經山方《改良紫微斗數全書》四卷一册
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Jeju National University Central Library
sources.quality_notes: Catalog spelling 校經山方 is retained, separately from the Yeungnam four-book record. Catalog mentions one duplicate; the report does not add it as another independently verified copy or equate printings.

sources.title: 尊经阁兩儀堂《紫微斗數全書》六卷六册
sources.provider: KORCIS via National Library of Korea; Sungkyunkwan University Jongyeonggak
sources.quality_notes: The catalog assigns late Qing, China, six juan/six books, ten lines and 24 characters, and records 兩儀堂藏板. The original colophon and its exact date were not inspected.
